extra.reason: Implemented: asymmetric relaxed BCE and Tversky mirroring metrics.relaxed, plus rigid label jitter. Verified flat loss inside the radius and sharp outside; end-to-end training smoke test green. --tolerance-m 0 preserves the strict path for A/B.

Shipped as a mixture, not a replacement. Verified the band-limited component lifts mrm_10m perturbation 0.083 -> 0.110 at 0.5 m with the tread sweep unchanged; 4 ms/crop overhead. Correlation length sampled 4-8 m per crop.

Not a data problem -- my validation gate was buggy. It filled nodata with a global median before differencing, manufacturing cliffs at hole edges; Pearson over those extremes read 0.25 on kearsarge_pass (real: 0.85) and 0.12 on rae_lakes at 27% nodata (real: 0.78). Failure tracked nodata fraction, not DEM quality. Fixed in 0401e7d: nodata propagates as NaN, slope clipped at 60deg. Rejections 15 -> 1, and that one is 0.69 vs a 0.70 threshold. whitney_switchbacks recovered 0.44 -> 0.876, rae_lakes -> 0.834, kearsarge_pass -> 0.895. The resolution-fallback and misregistration tests recorded on this issue were sound measurements, just aimed at a phantom.

labels.tif band 4 codes active/faint/lifecycle; bucket logic consolidated into osm.visibility_class. Verified coded pixels == target pixels. Added 'trailer relabel' (no downloads, manifest-guarded against racing the builder); 72 tiles relabelled. Unblocks the stratified selection metric and stratified sampling.

Class-first sampling with an equal-thirds default; verified 0.323/0.326/0.351 (train) and 0.252/0.350/0.399 (val) over 400 draws. Renormalises loudly when a split lacks a class. Falls back for pre-class-band tiles.

data.py now reads dem1m.tif for BODY_RES variants; tiles without one are skipped rather than silently substituted (72/74 have one). Re-measured viability against the real product: incision retained 0.75 active / 0.99 faint / 0.54 lifecycle, materially worse than the 1.10-1.12 the block-mean proxy suggested. README corrected.
Fixed in the same change as trailer-440.1; verified both variants now score identical labelled ground on all held-out tiles.

Selection is now mean over (variant x visibility class) of best-threshold relaxed F1, via metrics.Stratified. Class plane plumbed through TileDataset and full_tile; labels.py class precedence corrected to genuinely lowest-code-wins; tests/test_metrics.py pins the behaviour.

Dem3dep.kt: exportImage float32 fetch in UTM, JDK ImageIO decode verified bit-identical to rasterio, and a catalog-based resolution guard (LowPS) that refuses the 1/3-arc-second and IFSAR fallbacks. 12 tests. Partial-coverage gap filed as trailer-lxp.8.
Coverage now measured by footprint union, not min(LowPS) over intersecting rasters. 27 plugin tests green.
Heatmap layer, ramp and overlay geometry complete; 49 plugin tests green. Inference wiring belongs to lxp.3.

Fixed in a41f029 by removing the Kotlin formula rather than parity-testing it. export_onnx emits step_px/stride/overlap/pad_mode as numbers via infer.window_step; Kotlin reads them through ModelSpec. 56 plugin tests green.

MIT for code (LICENSE), CC BY-SA 4.0 for weights (LICENSE-MODEL), ODbL position stated and reasoned, attribution enforced in the sidecar via ModelSpec and in Overlay's constructor, shown in the layer info panel, mapper guidance in README. Commit 030bd37.

Inference.kt runs the OrtSession over a whole raster; whole-tile parity vs infer.predict at 3.9e-7 (tolerance 1e-5), mutation-checked at 1.0 for a one-column window shift. Covers dem1 (stride 1) and a stride-2 case. Commit dac83df.

Fixed in dea007d. atomic.staged writes to a temporary beside the destination and renames on success, so a partial points.laz is never visible under the real name -- covering SIGKILL/power-loss, which build_all's cleanup handler could not. check_complete compares the header's declared point count against the number point_stats actually decoded, which addresses the short-but-readable case PDAL exited 0 on. Same mechanism applied to the OSM and 3DEP coverage caches, which had the same shape (loud rather than silent failures, but nothing cleans them up). Mutation-checked: reverting to direct writes fails both extract_points tests. 27 Python tests, up from 19.
